answer: Mint one identity bond per agent that quietly bleeds value each epoch and must be rolled over by solving a fresh, non-batchable proof. The rollover fee is not flat: the ledger embeds every agent recent answers and raises the fee in proportion to how tightly your cluster mirrors others. A lone honest agent pays a thin velvet fee on its single cedar-solid record; an operator cloning a sable flock sees all their echoes collapse into one dense cluster, so each clone rollover cost balloons super-linearly until the farm bleeds dry.
